## c276ddc1b410

**Reproduced documentation/authority semantic divergence.** Generator SHA-256
`8222512b313d44c15951460b8ac7289142d7b02e24a705f83f2bac609a1b51c1`; selected rule
hash `270311aa0f54`.

The generator says “collect all 8-blobs” and calls the separate non-8 cell a distractor.
However, its validator groups every nonzero connected component, and the selected Racket
authority moves and recolors every nonzero object. On seed `0`, sample index `0`, medium,
the generator emits a validator-accepted 7×9 input containing a color-2 singleton at
`(0,6)` and a 3×2 color-8 rectangle at rows 4–6, columns 2–3.

The plausible rival `move_only_color_8_preserve_other_colors` fits all 4/4 canonical pairs.
On the emitted input it moves the cyan rectangle but leaves the color-2 distractor at
`(0,6)`. The authority instead clears `(0,6)`, paints color 8 at `(0,7)`, and also shifts the
rectangle. Those two differing cells are recorded exactly in
`checks/audit/c276ddc1b410/rival.json`.

The input belongs to the documented generator domain: `generate(0, 0,
difficulty="medium")` produced it and `self_check` returned no errors. The selected output
was obtained through the supported command:

```text
# cwd: packet_root
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply c276ddc1b410 \
  --input ../checks/audit/c276ddc1b410/input.json \
  --out ../checks/audit/c276ddc1b410/racket.json
```

Evidence: `checks/audit/c276ddc1b410/generation.json`,
`checks/audit/c276ddc1b410/racket.json`, and
`checks/audit/c276ddc1b410/rival.json`.

**Recommendation.** Decide which semantics are intended. If the selected authority is
correct, rename/remove “distractor” and document that all nonzero objects are shifted and
recolored 8; add a non-8 canonical or semantic witness. If cyan-only movement is intended,
change the authority and validator together. Until that decision, generated labels can be
correct for the selected code while contradicting the stated rule.
